title: Figure 2.7: Wright's guinea-pig coat-color path diagram
content: Sewall Wright's first path diagram. Parental heredity and chance select gametes; paired parental gametes determine each offspring's heredity; developmental, environmental, and hereditary factors determine the displayed coat-color phenotypes. The two offspring share their post-birth environmental factor but have separate developmental histories.
